"""Install the authorized Develative bridge, initially with WhatsApp disabled.

Existing authentication and unrelated services are not changed by this script.
Run once as root from the deployed project virtual environment.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import grp
import json
import os
import pwd
import secrets
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from cryptography.fernet import Fernet

ROOT = Path('/srv/openai-codex/projects/whatsapp-personal')
HOME = Path('/var/lib/whatsapp-personal-waha')
CONF = Path('/etc/whatsapp-personal')
USER = 'whatsappbridge'
os.umask(0o077)
try:
    account = pwd.getpwnam(USER)
except KeyError:
    subprocess.run(['useradd', '--system', '--create-home', '--home-dir', str(HOME),
                    '--shell', '/usr/sbin/nologin', USER], check=True)
    account = pwd.getpwnam(USER)
if account.pw_dir != str(HOME):
    raise SystemExit('Existing service user has unexpected home')
uid, gid = account.pw_uid, account.pw_gid
# Grant this one service traversal through the otherwise root-only project area.
# Other project directories and this project's private/ directory remain closed.
subprocess.run(['setfacl', '-m', f'u:{USER}:--x', '/srv/openai-codex',
                '/srv/openai-codex/projects'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['setfacl', '-m', f'u:{USER}:r-x', str(ROOT)], check=True)
for path, flag in [('/etc/subuid', '--add-subuids'), ('/etc/subgid', '--add-subgids')]:
    ranges = [line.split(':') for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if line]
    if not any(v[0] == USER for v in ranges):
        start = max([100000] + [int(v[1]) + int(v[2]) for v in ranges])
        subprocess.run(['usermod', flag, f'{start}-{start + 65535}', USER], check=True)

for path, mode in [(CONF, 0o750), (Path('/var/lib/whatsapp-personal'), 0o700),
                   (HOME, 0o700), (HOME / 'sessions', 0o700), (HOME / 'media', 0o700),
                   (HOME / '.config', 0o700), (HOME / '.config/containers', 0o700),
                   (HOME / '.config/containers/systemd', 0o700)]:
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.chown(path, 0 if path == CONF else uid, gid)
    os.chmod(path, mode)
for name in ['webhook.key', 'encryption.key', 'waha.key']:
    path = CONF / name
    if not path.exists():
        path.write_text(Fernet.generate_key().decode() if name == 'encryption.key' else secrets.token_hex(32))
    os.chown(path, 0, gid)
    os.chmod(path, 0o640)
cfgpath = CONF / 'config.toml'
if cfgpath.exists():
    raise SystemExit('Configuration already exists; inspect before changing it')
identity = json.loads((ROOT / 'private/identity.json').read_text())
cfg = (ROOT / 'deploy/bridge.example.toml').read_text()
cfg = cfg.replace('https://YOUR-OAUTH-ISSUER.example/.well-known/jwks.json',
                  'https://identity.example.invalid/jwks.json')
cfg = cfg.replace('https://YOUR-OAUTH-ISSUER.example', 'https://identity.example.invalid')
cfg = cfg.replace('REPLACE_WITH_EXACT_OAUTH_SUBJECT', identity['subject'])
cfgpath.write_text(cfg)
os.chown(cfgpath, 0, gid)
os.chmod(cfgpath, 0o640)

wrapper = ROOT / 'scripts/as-user'
wrapper.write_text(f'#!/bin/sh\nset -eu\ncd {HOME}\nexec runuser -u {USER} -- env HOME={HOME} XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/{uid} DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/{uid}/bus "$@"\n')
os.chmod(wrapper, 0o755)
unit = Path('/etc/systemd/system/whatsapp-personal.service')
shutil.copyfile(ROOT / 'deploy/whatsapp-personal.service', unit)
os.chmod(unit, 0o644)
quadlet = HOME / '.config/containers/systemd/whatsapp-waha.container'
shutil.copyfile(ROOT / 'prepared/whatsapp-waha.container', quadlet)
os.chown(quadlet, uid, gid)
os.chmod(quadlet, 0o600)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'scripts/resource_priority.py'),'enroll','--user',USER,'--apply'],check=True)
subprocess.run(['loginctl', 'enable-linger', USER], check=True)
subprocess.run(['systemctl', 'start', f'user@{uid}.service'], check=True)
subprocess.run([str(wrapper), 'podman', 'secret', 'create', 'whatsapp-waha-api-key', str(CONF / 'waha.key')], check=True, capture_output=True)
subprocess.run([str(wrapper), 'podman', 'secret', 'create', 'whatsapp-waha-disabled-ui-key', '-'],
               input=secrets.token_hex(32), text=True, check=True, capture_output=True)
subprocess.run(['systemctl', 'daemon-reload'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['systemctl', 'enable', '--now', 'whatsapp-personal.service'], check=True)
subprocess.run([str(wrapper), 'systemctl', '--user', 'daemon-reload'], check=True)
print(json.dumps({'service_user': USER, 'uid': uid, 'bridge_started': True,
                  'whatsapp_account_enabled': False, 'waha_started': False}))
